compiled_state.title: As an operator, superseded bugs 8ee4-c51c-c546-4d4e and cafb-4b97-1703-41e3 are closed with passing reproducers that verify the fixed behavior
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Write reproducers for bugs 8ee4 (DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE>=2 incorrectly computed on session→main PR) and cafb (squash-merged sub-branch commits not accepted as provenanced), verify them passing, and close both bugs.

**Why**: SC6 requires that both superseded bugs are closed with running reproducers, not just marked resolved. Reproducers confirm the architectural changes (S5, S6) actually fix the root causes rather than working around them.

**Scope**:
- IN: Write and run the 8ee4 reproducer: write a defense via review_defense_store_write, push a triggering commit to session→main PR, observe cycle-2 integration review skipping the defended finding (exit 0); write and run the cafb reproducer: create a story sub-branch PR, squash-merge it into session, run verify-session-provenance.sh against the session→main PR including that squash commit — verifier exits 0; close both bug tickets with --reason="Fixed: <summary>" after reproducers pass; add reproducers as test fixtures in tests/scripts/
- OUT: Any new architecture changes (the bugs are fixed by S5 and S6; this story only writes the reproducers and closes the tickets)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, bug 8ee4-c51c-c546-4d4e is closed with a passing reproducer: DSO_REVIEW_CYCLE>=2 is computed correctly on the session→main PR and a TrackerDefenseStore defense suppresses the defended finding in the integration review (reproducer exits 0)
  ← Satisfies: "Superseded bugs closed with reproducers passing — bug 8ee4" (SC6)
- When this story is complete, bug cafb-4b97-1703-41e3 is closed with a passing reproducer: a squash-merged story PR's commits are accepted as provenanced by verify-session-provenance.sh (reproducer exits 0)
  ← Satisfies: "Superseded bugs closed with reproducers passing — bug cafb" (SC6)
- When this story is complete, both reproducers are added to tests/scripts/ and documented so they can run in CI
  ← Satisfies: SC6 "reproducers passing" (not just locally)
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Testing] Reproducers must be runnable in CI (not just locally). The cafb reproducer depends on verify-session-provenance.sh (S5) correctly resolving squash-merged commits via DSO-Story-Merge trailer (S2). Ensure S5 and S2 are fully implemented before running reproducers.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
